messages:
Aisha (PM): quick run: finalize pilot scope for Optimize Toolkit — batching templates, caching playbook + small SDK, quant profiles, and eval-triggered alerts. keep v1 narrow.
Dev (Eng-ML): agree. biggest risk is silent quality regressions from quant. need per-customer prompt baselines and an automated rollback rule.
Samir (Solutions): customers asked for ready-to-drop-in examples: chat, long-embed, batch-rerank. we should ship those 3.
Morgan (SRE): telemetry must include batch_size histogram, cache_hit_rate, quant_fallback_events, p95 token latency. dashboards required before pilot.
Rae (Product Ops): proposed acceptance checklist:
- Dashboards with telemetry live for pilot orgs
- Performance: latency-first preset keeps p95 <= baseline*1.15; cost-first shows >=10% cost reduction on Streamly traces
- Quality: eval score drop <= 1.0% on curated per-customer prompts
- Safety: automatic fallback implemented with opt-out toggle for safety-focused customers
- Docs: playbook, runbook, and 3 sample configs published
Lee (Eng-Platform): implementation notes: batching templates and router yaml snippets can ship in ~3 sprints; caching SDK helper (prefix hashing + TTL) in ~1.5 weeks; quant calibration prototype in 3 wks.
Dev (Eng-ML): define quality delta as (baseline - test)/baseline*100 using acceptability+semantic-sim ensemble. rollback threshold 1.0%.
Samir (Solutions): ACME wants auto-fallback OFF by default; Streamly wants cost-first preset with auto-fallback ON. we'll surface as tenant knobs.
Morgan (SRE): runbook alerting rules to add:
- p95_latency increase > 20% over 1h -> P1 alert
- cache_hit_rate < 45% for 10m -> investigate
- eval_quality_drop > 1.0% -> flag rollout and trigger fallback if tenant enabled
- fallback_triggered > 3 times in 10m -> page oncall
Aisha (PM): owners & dates: Dev -> batching + quant proto (3w); Lee -> caching SDK + metrics (2w); Morgan -> dashboards + alerts (1.5w); Samir -> customer test traces + acceptance plan (1w); Rae -> docs + runbook + pilot kickoff (1w).
ci-bot: Reminder: product roadmap sync Wed 10:00 in #product :calendar:
Aisha (PM): ok locking in these decisions. I'll update the PRD and send invites for the kickoff. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
